seo.description: Dr Hongxia Rena Zhang (BMed, MMed, MD(Oncology), DipPallCare, FRACGP) practises at Sans Souci Doctors. Consultant Specialist GP.

hero.lede: Independent practitioner working from our Sans Souci Doctors premises. Consultant Specialist GP.

paragraphs: Dr Rena Zhang (Dr Hongxia) is an independant Specialist GP (ABN: 74 633 990 360) (MED0001208416) consulting at the Sans Souci centre.
Dr Zhang holds a Bachelor of Medicine, Master of Medicine, Doctorate of Medicine in Molecular Oncology research, and a Diploma in Palliative Medicine.

Dr Zhang has been delivering compassionate and dedicated care to communities, with her practice focuses on preventative medicine, supporting individuals to achieve and maintain their health and wellbeing. Her doctoral research background in molecular oncology research has enriched her understanding of complex medical conditions, further enhancing her ability to support patients in achieving their health goals.

With a strong interest in mental health, women’s health and preventative health assessments, Dr Zhang provides comprehensive, personalised care tailored to each patient’s needs, ensuring they feel supported at every stage of their health journey.

fellowships: Specialist in General Practice, Medical Board of Australia
